texts.summary: The Tuscan ambassador and Don Juan discuss neutral custody of Chateau d'If. The Grand Duke cannot compel Bussetto or surrender the Italian garrison's position without breaking his promise. (Francesco Guicciardini? to Ferdinando I de Medici, Grand Duke of Tuscany, 10 May 1597, as given in George Lasry's report.)
